description: Rebrand metadata + PWA to 'Xcellence POS'. Independent of FEAT-002/003. Edits app.json branding, replaces public/manifest.json (and mirrors dist/manifest.json) to match the live manifest exactly, and hand-edits dist/index.html head (title/lang/theme/manifest link/splash/noscript) to match the live site without touching the hashed JS bundle. No TypeScript/screen changes.
steps: Edit app.json: set expo.name='Xcellence POS'. Under expo.web set name='Xcellence POS', shortName='POS', themeColor='#EA580C', backgroundColor='#FFF9F4'. Keep slug='pos-mobile', expo.web.output='single', and ALL other fields unchanged.

Replace public/manifest.json with the exact live manifest from the task spec: name 'Xcellence POS'; short_name 'POS'; description 'ระบบขายหน้าร้าน PWA — ชำระเงิน คูปอง สมาชิก CRM กะการขาย ใบเสร็จ รองรับออฟไลน์'; start_url '/?target=pos'; scope '/'; display 'standalone'; display_override ['window-controls-overlay','standalone','minimal-ui']; background_color '#FFF9F4'; theme_color '#EA580C'; orientation 'any'; lang 'th'; dir 'ltr'; icons [{/icon-pos.svg any image/svg+xml any},{/icon-192.png 192x192 image/png 'any maskable'},{/icon-512.png 512x512 image/png 'any maskable'}]; shortcuts (4: หน้าขาย /?target=pos, ประวัติขาย /?target=pos&route=salehistory, หน้าจอลูกค้า /?display=1, Kiosk Mode /?target=pos&kiosk=1, each with icon /icon-192.png 192x192); screenshots (2: /screenshots/pos-sale.png 1280x800 wide 'หน้าขาย POS', /screenshots/pos-mobile.png 390x844 narrow 'POS บน Mobile'); categories ['business','productivity']; related_applications []; prefer_related_applications false.
Copy the same manifest JSON into dist/manifest.json so the committed export matches.

Hand-edit dist/index.html head: <html lang="th">; <title>Xcellence POS — ระบบขายหน้าร้าน</title>; <meta name="description" content="...manifest description...">; theme-color '#EA580C'; add <link rel="manifest" href="/manifest.json">, <link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/icon-192.png">, <link rel="icon" href="/icon-pos.svg">; set body/#root background '#FFF9F4'; add inline #splash SVG with a pulse animation + text 'กำลังโหลด POS...'; Thai <noscript>'กรุณาเปิดใช้งาน JavaScript'. Do NOT modify the hashed <script src="/_expo/static/js/web/index-<hash>.js"> tag or any /_expo asset path.

Create public/index.html as a documentation template-of-record mirroring the new dist/index.html head (so future `npm run web:build` has a reference). Add a short HTML comment noting app.json injects title/theme on export and a custom template is needed to reproduce the splash.
acceptance_criteria: node -e check on app.json passes: expo.name and expo.web.name === 'Xcellence POS', themeColor '#EA580C', backgroundColor '#FFF9F4', shortName 'POS', slug 'pos-mobile', web.output 'single'.

node -e check on public/manifest.json AND dist/manifest.json passes: name 'Xcellence POS', start_url '/?target=pos', theme_color '#EA580C', dir 'ltr', icons.length 3, shortcuts.length 4, screenshots.length 2.
dist/index.html contains lang="th", 'Xcellence POS', '#EA580C', rel="manifest", 'กำลังโหลด POS', and STILL contains the original '_expo/static/js/web/index-' script reference unchanged.
verification: node -e "const j=require('./app.json');const w=j.expo.web;if(j.expo.name!=='Xcellence POS'||w.name!=='Xcellence POS'||w.themeColor!=='#EA580C'||w.backgroundColor!=='#FFF9F4'||w.shortName!=='POS'||j.expo.slug!=='pos-mobile'||w.output!=='single')throw new Error('app.json mismatch');console.log('app.json OK')"

node -e "for(const p of ['./public/manifest.json','./dist/manifest.json']){const m=require(p);if(m.name!=='Xcellence POS'||m.start_url!=='/?target=pos'||m.theme_color!=='#EA580C'||m.dir!=='ltr'||m.icons.length!==3||m.shortcuts.length!==4||m.screenshots.length!==2)throw new Error('manifest mismatch '+p)}console.log('manifest OK')"

node -e "const h=require('fs').readFileSync('dist/index.html','utf8');['lang=\"th\"','Xcellence POS','#EA580C','rel=\"manifest\"','กำลังโหลด POS','_expo/static/js/web/index-'].forEach(s=>{if(!h.includes(s))throw new Error('missing '+s)});console.log('index.html OK')"
findings: Brand = 'Xcellence POS' (short_name 'POS'). Canonical manifest description string (reuse verbatim everywhere incl. index.html meta description): 'ระบบขายหน้าร้าน PWA — ชำระเงิน คูปอง สมาชิก CRM กะการขาย ใบเสร็จ รองรับออฟไลน์' (note the EM DASH ' — ' U+2014 with spaces, not a hyphen). Colors: themeColor/theme_color '#EA580C', background '#FFF9F4'. dist/index.html <title> = 'Xcellence POS — ระบบขายหน้าร้าน'. PWA start_url '/?target=pos', scope '/'. Icon paths referenced but NOT yet created as assets: /icon-pos.svg, /icon-192.png, /icon-512.png, /screenshots/pos-sale.png, /screenshots/pos-mobile.png (FEAT-002/003 may need to add these under public/). public/index.html added as a template-of-record ONLY (Expo export does not consume it by default; app.json injects title/theme at build). The hashed bundle reference index-12750d73f6fcafe7fdccf02754fdf050.js was left unchanged. All 3 FEAT-001 verification one-liners pass.
